Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 building permit counts, left-joining pre-aggregated tract totals so tracts with zero permits appear with 0, ordered by count descending then tract name.
sql:
WITH pc AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS permit_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_d424f6'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(pc.permit_count, 0) AS permit_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
ORDER BY permit_count DESC, t.name
LIMIT 200
